limitations: The phase diagram and robust tuning theorem are exact for A=gamma L J and B=LJ. They give necessary obstruction ceilings for universal theorems, not a universal convergence guarantee. Only the abstract of arXiv:2609.15936 was inspected, leaving a material source-specific originality risk.
provenance: Exact Schur-stability analysis of the constant-reflection forward-reflected-backward method on the planar split-skew family, compared with recent sharp FRB, constant-reflection FRB, generalized optimistic-gradient, and generalized FRB literature.
record_title: Optimal reflection tuning against split-skew FRB obstructions
